title: Star Wars Mandalorian Baby Yoda 20oz Tumbler - Used, No Straw
categoryName: Collectibles:Science Fiction & Horror:Star Wars Collectibles:Other Star Wars Collectibles
descriptionText: This 20oz tumbler features the beloved character Yoda from the popular TV series The Mandalorian. It is perfect for any Star Wars fan and comes from the Star Wars Celebration convention/event. The tumbler is made in China and is not vintage. It is a great addition to any Star Wars collection and is perfect for display or use. The tumbler does not come with a straw and is not signed.
